children.design_delta_summary: 1) Replace session-owned conditional-release state with a frozen payload-bound Release Capsule CID. 2) Keep the split-template parent strength, but make the normative surface concrete with mandatory sections for unknown handling, failure evidence, vocabulary/lineage, composition, and long-horizon assumptions. 3) Add explicit refusal/replay records and unknown-codec fallback so peers can stay opaque, auditable, and evolution-safe.

1) Replace reference-first authority with contract-first dual-surface freeze artifacts plus a non-normative executable witness. 2) Add a shared outer/feed evidence ledger for opaque-pass and refusal outcomes such as unknown codec preserve-forward, replay reject, and per-hop authorization deny. 3) Require per-surface supersession manifests with explicit merge links and spec-local vocabulary mappings when frozen surfaces evolve.
